rng = np.random.default_rng(5)
x = np.array([12, 15, 11, 18,
              14, 22, 9, 16])
bm = rng.choice(x, size=(5000, 8),
                replace=True).mean(axis=1)
np.percentile(bm, [2.5, 97.5])
# [12.    17.375]
caption: Illustrative: a rough 95% interval for the mean.
